More details · Find a dealer High-Gain Heavy Rock Tone - Delivers massive amounts of gain with a focused, tight, and pronounced bass response specifically designed for guitarists seeking authentic heavy rock and aggressive distortion sounds Tone-Preserving Circuitry - Maintains your guitar's fundamental tone and clearly transmits every nuance of your playing style, ensuring dynamic response and articulation even at extreme gain settings Attack & Edge Controls - Advanced tone-shaping options allow radical adjustments to the distortion character and voice, providing versatile sonic variations from tight modern crunch to saturated heavy tones without compromising sound quality True Bypass Switching - Ensures complete signal transparency when disengaged, preserving your original guitar tone without any coloration or signal degradation Flexible Power Options - Operates on standard 9V battery for portability or 9V power supply (not included) for reliable performance in studio and live settings Carl Martin Heavy Drive Browse current products Find a dealer All about Carl Martin Heavy Drive The Carl Martin Heavy Drive is a premium distortion pedal engineered for guitarists who demand the big, heavy sound without compromising tonal quality. This pedal excels at delivering the massive gain and sonic weight required for heavy rock applications while maintaining the clarity and definition that separates professional-grade distortion from muddy, compressed alternatives. What sets the Heavy Drive apart is its focus on tight, pronounced bass response combined with exceptional amounts of gain. The pedal's carefully voiced circuit ensures that even at extreme settings, your guitar's fundamental character shines through, clearly conveying every nuance of your playing technique and dynamics. The Attack and Edge controls provide comprehensive tone-shaping capabilities, allowing you to make radical changes to the distortion's character and voice. Whether you're dialing in tight, modern aggression or saturated vintage-inspired heavy tones, these controls offer extensive sonic variation without ever sacrificing sound quality or clarity. Like all Carl Martin pedals, the Heavy Drive features true bypass switching to maintain perfect signal integrity when the effect is disengaged. The pedal can be powered by either a standard 9V battery for portable use or a 9V power supply (not included) for dependable studio and stage performance. Specifications No specifications added yet.
